Privacy policy

Last updated 2026-10-25

This policy explains what information PlanCraft 3D ("we", "the site") handles when you use this website and the planner. We keep it short and plain.

Your drawings

Your floor plans, prices and settings are stored in your own browser (local storage) and are not uploaded to our servers. If you clear your browser data, they are removed. Use Save / Load to keep a file copy.

Information collected automatically

We use Google Analytics to count visits and understand which pages and features are used. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies and may collect your IP address, device and browser information, and pages viewed. We do not combine this with your name or contact details.

Advertising

This site may show ads served by Google AdSense and other Google advertising services. Google and its partners use cookies to serve ads based on your visits to this and other sites. You can manage personalised ads at Google Ads Settings, and learn how Google uses data from sites that use its services at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites. In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, we ask for your consent before using cookies for personalised ads.

Cookies

Cookies come from the analytics and advertising services above. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some features of third-party services may stop working if you do.

Third-party services

The planner loads open-source libraries (React, Three.js, jsPDF) and styles from public content delivery networks, which receive your IP address when your browser requests them.

Children

The site is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Your choices

You can use the planner without creating an account. You can opt out of Google Analytics with the browser add-on.

Changes

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact us through the project page on GitHub (open an issue).
